# sink_wire_caddy — repaired realism QA

Evidence: f0008, f0168, f3684. Calibrations and source images are retained in ../measurements.json and ../evidence/.

- Replaced seven solid panel colliders with individual wire-segment hulls, preserving all grid gaps and raised feet.

Open wire basket with raised feet and wire-level convex contact pieces. Cloths obscure rear/base wires, so hidden rod count remains inferred. Round 2 pose and dimensions were re-fitted from three fixed calibrated views with support height constrained to the current cabinetry countertop at 1.005 m. Hidden details and material parameters remain estimated.

Physics: Estimated steel wire length and 2.7 mm grid/4.8 mm rim diameter; no product weight available. Mass 0.32 kg, friction 0.35, restitution 0.05. All are estimates, not measured product values. See model.json physics for COM, density and material model.

No manipulation was observed. Joints and ranges remain unverified assumptions. See ../qa_report.json and ../qa_summary.md for measured comparisons and outstanding limitations.

## Round 2

Source-pose grades: silhouette B, proportions B, color_texture B, articulation B, physics B, collision B, instances B. Mean silhouette IoU 0.788.

- Round 2: re-measured source depth/planes in f0008, f0168, f3684; refitted pose/dimensions at the current 1.005 m support.
- Round 2: replaced round top rail with a flat open metal band and added four individual rubber foot pads.
- Round 2: matched matte powder-coat roughness; corrected colour evaluation to use source-visible black wire, retaining legacy cloth-contaminated histogram values.

Remaining: Cloths hide wires; envelope IoU cannot certify individual rod locations/count; colour checks use opaque wire pixels only and remain occlusion-sensitive. Mass, friction and centre of mass are estimates; real product weight unavailable. Photo scores apply to the source-fit pose on the retained 1.005 m support. supported.xml uses the distinct contact-seated pose on the current tilted cabinet; that adjusted pose is not certified by these photo scores.
